name: Koll the Forgemaster
description: The greatest of the dwarves, the only one who can work Tyrite, who was making the Sword of the Realms and was pushed into his forge by Tibalt.

timeline.summary: Disguised as Valki, Tibalt visits Koll the Forgemaster, who refuses to hand over the Sword of the Realms, and pushes him into his forge.
timeline.quote: so Tibalt did the realms a favor and pushed the obnoxious dwarf right into his own forge

relations.note: Tibalt pushes Koll into his forge.
relations.quote: pushed the obnoxious dwarf right into his own forge

relations.note: Koll forged the sword before dying.
relations.quote: Koll must have finally finished the bloody thing

pages_say.description: The greatest of the dwarves, the only one who can work Tyrite, who was making the Sword of the Realms and was pushed into his forge by Tibalt.
The smith who finished the Sword of the Realms and died, taking the secret of wielding it to the grave.
